displayName: stocks: thesis round leaves the book unread

documentation.subject: MyBrainStock · tesis sin leer ${log.extracted_label.runs} noches · ${log.extracted_label.user}
documentation.content:
The night's thesis round (`briefing.read_theses`, run by the schedule's tick before the card) left theses unread two rounds in a row or more (`briefing.thesis_pass_short`). Account `${log.extracted_label.user}`: `${log.extracted_label.left}` of `${log.extracted_label.owed}` unread, `${log.extracted_label.fetched}` fetched in time, `${log.extracted_label.asked}` judge calls. The card names those theses as not checked, so the reader is told; this is the round not fitting the book.

Read the numbers: `fetched` well under `owed` = the news feeds are slow (`THESIS_PASS_FETCH_S`); `asked` at `THESIS_PASS_MAX_CALLS` = the call cap; neither = the time budget (`THESIS_PASS_S`), usually the free models throttling (`llm.free.over_tpm`). Logged every round the streak lasts.

Triage: `uv run stocks logs tail --since 48h --event briefing.thesis_pass --json`, then `uv run stocks logs tail --since 24h --user ${log.extracted_label.user} --grep thesis` and `--event llm.free.over_tpm`.
